attempts.note: The API itself is gone: on 2026-11-13 every /api/v1 route probed (topictree, topic/math, exercises, videos/x, badges, user) answers HTTP 410 'API removed. Please see https://github.com/Khan/khan-api for details', /api/auth2/request_token answers 404 'API removed.', and /api/auth2/access_token 400. No /openapi.json, /swagger.json or similar was ever served.

Khan's only machine-readable catalogue: the API Explorer (removed from Khan/khan-api in commit 5b848d8, 2019-11-07) loaded every endpoint's url/http_method/arguments/returns/access_control from /api/v1/v1_api_descriptions. The live host now serves a bot-challenge page; archive.org lists a 2014-08-06 snapshot (web.archive.org/web/20140806201106/...) but the Wayback host is unreachable from this environment (connection reset; WebFetch refuses web.archive.org). Re-capturing that snapshot would let this spec be cross-checked against the vendor's own list.

Vendor repo. README gives the removal timetable. The wiki (github.com/Khan/khan-api.wiki.git) had its pages 'Destroyed' in 2020, but git history keeps them: Khan-Academy-API-Methods.md (last version before 8ecc3b8, 2013-07-18: every endpoint with parameters and example responses), Khan-Academy-API.md and Khan-Academy-API-Authentication.md (8ec30de: the OAuth 1.0a auth2 flow). These recovered pages are the source for all 26 /api/v1 operations' shapes and the 6 auth operations.

Third-party Node wrapper by a khan-api contributor; used only to confirm the post-2013 surface (same endpoints plus /exercises/perseus_autocomplete, /user/exercises/progress_changes and the internal /api/internal/graphql, /api/internal/user/missions and /api/v2/topics/topictree). Those undocumented/internal routes are NOT modelled: no vendor documentation of their shapes exists.
No khanacademy entry among 2529 apis.guru APIs.
No vendor-owned Postman workspace or SwaggerHub API; third-party directories (apis.io, apitracker) only restate that the API was deprecated.

sources: https://github.com/Khan/khan-api/wiki (git history: Khan-Academy-API-Methods.md @ 8ecc3b8^, Khan-Academy-API.md and Khan-Academy-API-Authentication.md @ 8ec30de)
notes: Khan Academy's public REST API v1 no longer exists: Khan removed /badges, /user and /playlists on 2020-01-06 and the content routes (/topictree, /topic, /videos, /exercises) on 2020-07-29, and on 2026-11-13 every route returns 410 'API removed' (the auth2 request_token returns 404). The OpenFn adaptor's only operation, fetch(), still performs the auth2 request_token -> POST authorize (app owner's email/password) -> access_token flow and then GETs https://www.khanacademy.org/api/v1/<getEndpoint>, so every run of it fails; the adaptor is effectively dead and this spec is a historical record for mocks and for anyone retiring the adaptor. 'Full' here is the whole documented v1 surface as Khan last published it: 26 GET operations (topics, the topic tree, deprecated playlist aliases, videos, exercises, badges, the user and the user's video/exercise histories and logs) plus the 6 OAuth 1.0a operations of the v2 and legacy v1 flows, recovered from the git history of Khan's deleted khan-api wiki pages, with response schemas taken from the documented example responses (every list is a bare JSON array). It is best-effort/partial-docs because those pages date from 2013 and the API Explorer catalogue that superseded them (v1_api_descriptions) could not be retrieved; endpoints that only third-party wrappers show (perseus_autocomplete, progress_changes, internal GraphQL) are deliberately left out. Every operation is marked deprecated with x-khan-removed-on. Usage-time fields (total_seconds_watched etc.) were dropped by Khan on 2019-11-30 but are kept as documented. Examples use placeholder identities instead of the wiki's sample emails.
